reason: A Feishu/Lark channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets users interact with agents, review approvals, manage sessions and workspaces, and exchange files through chat.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书或 Lark，让用户通过聊天派发任务、查看执行过程、处理审批并收发工作区文件。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Feishu or Lark so users can assign tasks, view execution progress, handle approvals, and exchange workspace files through chat.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Feishu/Lark chat
Sends agent responses, execution updates, approval cards, and files
Invokes DeepSeek Harness commands and tools through chat
Maintains persistent sessions across chats, threads, workspaces, and models
Supports workspace, model, and permission preset switching
Coordinates multiple agent instances in group chats
Stores or migrates Feishu application credentials through the configured credentials service or settings
